cutoff.source_sha: d34f31a (release/first-public, R6 commit; moves at R8)
cutoff.scope: Haskoki workspace sessions only (first commit 2026-09-24 through cutoff)

sessions_definition: A root session is one session_id (codex) or one session directory (muse). Resumed/continued codex sessions may span several rollout files (84 files for 82 bound roots at census time; one root spans 3 files); usage is deduplicated globally so continuations never double-count. Of 82 bound codex roots, 1 is the excluded ops session and 1 post-cutoff review session contributes nothing: 80 codex + 25 muse = 105 counted sessions, of which 10 muse sessions hold zero usage records (counted in inventory, contributing nothing). Later post-cutoff sessions grow the bound inventory without changing the aggregates.
binding_rule: A session counts iff its recorded working directory is the Haskoki workspace root (identifier HASKOKI_WORKSPACE) or a descendant path: codex session_meta cwd equals the root or starts with root + '/', same rule for runtime_workspace_roots; muse workspace_root markers likewise. Mention-grep rejected (nearly every in-scope file mentions haskoki, e.g. 350/352 at first scan); workspace binding admits 82, of which 80 contribute pre-cutoff usage. One bound session (ops disk-space check, no Haskoki work product) is EXCLUDED from all aggregates below.

field_definitions.input_tokens: Total input per call (INCLUDES cached tokens; never add cached on top).
field_definitions.cached_tokens: Subset of input served from cache (re-read context, not written code). codex: cached_input_tokens; muse: cached_tokens == cache_read_tokens (one quantity, counted once).
field_definitions.cache_write_tokens: Cache-creation tokens. Observed 0 on both harnesses.
field_definitions.output_tokens: Total output per call (INCLUDES reasoning tokens; never add reasoning on top).
field_definitions.reasoning_tokens: Subset of output spent on reasoning. codex: reasoning_output_tokens.
field_definitions.calls: Individual recorded model calls ONLY (codex: unique response_id; muse: unique model_completed record id). Workflow-child usage summaries are separate aggregate events, never calls.
field_definitions.summary_events: muse workflow_child_lifecycle usage summaries for child sessions outside the bound set. Token totals real; per-summary call counts unavailable; model not recorded in the summaries.

dedup: codex: global response_id dedup over all bound files (0 duplicates over 3298 records); per-record timestamp cutoff (18 post-cutoff records excluded). muse: record-id dedup (0 duplicates); 1 workflow-child summary excluded as dup of a bound child session; post-cutoff records excluded by recorded_at. Nesting cached<=input and reasoning<=output verified on every record (0 violations); codex total==input+output verified on every record.
inclusions: All recorded pre-cutoff calls regardless of outcome: failed requests, retries, reviews, release packaging. Parallel sessions are never summed as calendar hours.
